title: 2026-10-16 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：Beyond the Trial-and-Error Loop (AMD (Advanced Micro Devices, 单卡微基准加解析放大就能把多机训练吞吐投影到 10% 以内误差，配置)、Scaling LLM Inference via Parallelism (Dell Technologies (Office of CTO, prefill 越重越偏 PP，约束越松越偏 TP。)、JointServe (Beihang University, 比最强全模型换入换出基线快 21.7%，SLO 达成率最高提到 10)、CacheSmith (POSTECH, RAG prefill 的选择性重算拆成 WarmUp/Probe/)、PN-Mix (Seoul National University, 量化误差的 logit 影响由 query-key 对范数乘积决定，)、TreeSpark (Renmin University of China, 让草稿器在训练中就回放树的扩展与剪枝，平均接受长度比 DSpark )、Joint Subspace Sparse Attention for Effici (Seoul National University, 共享 query-key 子空间打分加免聚集索引 kernel，12)

highlights.name: Beyond the Trial-and-Error Loop
highlights.note: 把多机训练配置投影到单机秒级评估，Mixtral 吞吐 +27%

highlights.name: JointServe
highlights.note: 权重与 KV 统一驻留调度，SWE-bench SLO 达成率提到 76.8–100%

highlights.name: Joint Subspace Sparse Attention
highlights.note: 免聚集 token 级稀疏注意力，128K 解码吞吐达 full-KV 6.43 倍
